verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui sahaj samaadh sukh sa(n)paT samaane hai ||

en.bdb: By becoming a true servant of Satguru Ji, remaining fond of the fragrance of the dust of the holy feet of the True Guru, and in perpetual contemplation, a Sikh permeates himself in the spiritual peace.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੈਜਲ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਲਹਰ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਸਕੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਠਹਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bhaijal bhiaanak lahar na biaap sakai dhubidhaa nivaar ek Tek Thaharaane hai ||

en.bdb: Guru-conscious person is never affected by the frightening worldly waves of desires and hopes. He is deemed to have destroyed all duality and taken the refuge of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਰਜਿ ਬਿਸਰਜਿਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT sabadh surat baraj bisarajit prem nem bisam bisavaiaas ur aane hai ||

en.bdb: He keeps his eyes away from the evils and ears closed to the slander and praise. Ever engrossed in Naam Simran, he imbibes the celestial faith of the Lord in his mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੯੨॥
verses.translit_en: jeevan mukat jag jeevan jeevan mool aapaa khoi hoi apara(n)par paraane hai ||92||

en.bdb: Liberated Guru-conscious Sikh sheds all his ego and becomes a devotee of the infinite Lord, the creator of the World and source of all life on it. (92)
